text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- The renowned French Voyager tourist magazine is proposing Dalmatia as a 1997 tourist destination.
- The Villach-Ljubljana-Zagreb-Belgrade-Nis-Skopje-Solun international traffic corridor is to pass through Croatia.
- Opposition leaders voice their disagreement over the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) call for joint slates of all Croatian parties at the Eastern Slavonia elections.
- Analysis: Can Croatia's BBB- credit rating and its Eurobonds make the interest rates to fall? More significant decline for the time being seems far away.

- Zagreb has grown by 176,000 residents or some 22.7 percent over the past five years and its infrastructure is facing a collapse unless concrete programs for housebuilding, traffic, social security and childcare are made.
- Gale force winds sweep thorough Dalmatia over the weekend leaving a trail of destruction in their wake. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
